rationale.org-governance: Proposes an enterprise governance framework with accountability and review policies.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Mandates structured human review checkpoints and certification gates across migration.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Requires provenance documentation tracking AI model, source code, and reviewer.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Mandates differential testing comparing original and converted code outputs.
rationale.regulatory-compliance: Addresses regulatory audit requirements under financial regulations like SOX.
rationale.automation-bias: Analyzes automation bias causing unwarranted trust in compiled AI-migrated code.
